answer: Invitations form a quota tree, so each member vouches for a fixed number of newcomers, and a fraud charge upheld by an independent reviewer revokes that member's whole subtree instead of one account. The re-checker earns nothing for approving and a bounty for catching a fake, so an attacker must fund a real terrace of vouches, keep a vault of live bonds at every branch, and accept that one pigment mark of doubt erases hundreds of descendants at once.
